paite: Huan ka dak nawn a, ngai in, laibuzial leng ka mu hi.
heading: Laibuzial Leng Muhna

paite: Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Bang na mu a?" hon chi hi. Ke'n, “Laibuzial leng ka mu; huai dunglam tong sawmnih ahi a, availam tong sawm," ka chi hi.

Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Hiai gam pumpi tung a paikhia hamsia ahi, huai dungzui in kuapeuh guta tu a kipan satkhiak in a-om ding ua; huai dungzui in kuapeuh dikloupi a kichiamte tu a kipan satkhiak in a-om ding uh.
Ka paikhesak ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi a, gutami inn ah alut ding, ka min a zuau a hamsia zangmi inn ah; huan a-inn ah a-om gige dia, asing asuang toh anegai ding," achi hi.
Huchi in kei hon houpih angel apaikhia a, ka kiang ah, "Tu in dak inla, bang ahia paikhia chih en in," achi hi.
heading: Ephah Leh Numei Muhna

paite: Ke'n, "Bang ahia?" ka chi hi. Ama'n, "Hiai a paikhia 'Ephah' ahi, achi a, huai lou in, hiai, 'Gamsung tengteng a mite khelhna ahi," " achi hi.
Ngai in, "Ngensik dopkang in a-om a; huai Ephah sung a tu hiai numei ahi," achi lai hi.
Huan ama'n, “Hiai gitlouhna ahi," achi a; huai Ephah sung a-ensuak a; huai agong ah ngen gik angasuk hi.
Huchi in ka dak a, ngai in, numei nih hong paikhia ua, akhate uah huih a-om hi. Tuivapi bang in kha anei ua; huchi in lei leh van kikal ah huai Ephah adomtou uhi.
Kei hon houpih angel kiang ah, "Hiaite'n koilam a Ephah po ding uh ahia?" ka chi hi.
Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Shinar gam a inn ding lam ding in. Huan abawl zoh chiang un ama muntak ah koih in a-om ding," achi hi.
